meaningful_read.definition: Article page was visible for at least 45 seconds and reached at least 60% scroll depth in the same page load.
meaningful_read.evidenceBoundary: Signals sustained on-page reading behavior. Does not prove comprehension, agreement or demand.

hot_question_view.definition: A market hot-question block became at least 60% visible in the viewport.
hot_question_view.evidenceBoundary: Signals exposure to the question. Does not prove the reader considered or answered it.

workflow_intake_open.definition: Reader activated a link to the RESONANCE market-workflow GitHub issue form.
workflow_intake_open.evidenceBoundary: Signals intent to inspect the intake. Does not prove a workflow was submitted.

verified_workflow_open.definition: Reader activated a link to the Verified Workflow pilot from a market-question surface.
verified_workflow_open.evidenceBoundary: Signals interest in the pilot description. Does not prove pilot intent or qualification.

prohibitedCollection: IP address fields in the client payload

transport.activation: Set RESONANCE_ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT at publication build time.
requirements: collector privacy and retention contract reviewed separately
